attrs.evidence: Successor on a 6-path over |D| = 6 fails the property — its core is all of D with six singleton orbits — and find1PAViolation reports null at its default bounds. The witness appears only at maxAux 3. The bounded search remains a sound FALSIFIER: a hit exhibits its witness. It was never a decision procedure and this is the construction that says so. TIMELESS because the bounds are named in the statement: raising the defaults does not make a miss AT THESE BOUNDS conclusive, it produces a different proposition. R4.1 REMOVED AN OVERREACH HERE. R3.1 appended "FED-WITNESS-BOUND makes the minimum grow with Σ|R^A|, so no fixed bound is ever conclusive" — which is an upper bound on the minimum used as a lower one, and is false (FED-MIN-GROWS). The universal statement it was reaching for is now open as FED-1PA-NO-FIXED-BOUND, unsupported.
attrs.statement: A MISS from find1PAViolation at its default bounds (maxCon 3, maxAux 2) is evidence that Γ has the gluing property.
